description: This file defines a Java interface MetadataBuilder in a package related to entity metadata within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides a fluent API for building mutable Metadata objects with various set and remove methods for different data types and JSON structures.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, int, Predicate)
methods.description: Sets an integer metadata value conditionally based on a predicate.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, int)
methods.description: Sets an integer metadata value unconditionally.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, long, Predicate)
methods.description: Sets a long metadata value conditionally based on a predicate.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, long)
methods.description: Sets a long metadata value unconditionally.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, double, Predicate)
methods.description: Sets a double metadata value conditionally based on a predicate.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, double)
methods.description: Sets a double metadata value unconditionally.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, boolean, Predicate)
methods.description: Sets a boolean metadata value conditionally based on a predicate.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, boolean)
methods.description: Sets a boolean metadata value unconditionally.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, @Nullable String, Predicate)
methods.description: Sets a string metadata value conditionally based on a predicate.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, @Nullable String)
methods.description: Sets a string metadata value unconditionally.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, JsonValue, Predicate)
methods.description: Sets a JsonValue metadata conditionally.

methods.name: set(CharSequence, JsonValue)
methods.description: Sets a JsonValue metadata unconditionally.

methods.name: set(JsonFieldDefinition<T>, @Nullable T, Predicate)
methods.description: Sets a metadata value with a specific field definition conditionally.

methods.name: set(JsonField, Predicate)
methods.description: Sets a JsonField conditionally.

methods.name: set(JsonField)
methods.description: Sets a JsonField unconditionally.

methods.name: remove(CharSequence)
methods.description: Removes a metadata field by key.

methods.name: remove(JsonFieldDefinition)
methods.description: Removes a metadata field by field definition.

methods.name: setAll(Iterable<JsonField>, Predicate)
methods.description: Sets multiple fields conditionally.

methods.name: setAll(Iterable<JsonField>)
methods.description: Sets multiple fields unconditionally.

methods.name: removeAll()
methods.description: Removes all fields.

methods.name: build()
methods.description: Creates an immutable Metadata object containing the accumulated values.
